question: In Leh, the first ever ice climbing festival was celebrated in ______ valley in January 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nubra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In Leh, the first-ever ice climbing festival was celebrated in **Nubra valley** in January 2021.

 
 
• It was organized by **Nubra Adventure Club.**
 
• The ice climbing festival was organized to promote winter tourism in Nubra valley.
 
• The event was conducted on **seven days. **
 
• **18 participants** across Nubra valley including 4 women have taken part in Ice climbing event.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Nubra Valley** is the northernmost part of Jammu and Kashmir.

 
 
• Nubra is currently administered as a subdivision and a tehsil in the Leh district.
 
• It is known as the **Orchard of Ladakh.**
 
• It was originally called **Ldumra(valley of flowers).**
 
• Nubra was listed as one of the five natural and historical divisions of Ladakh by **Alexander Cunningham.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ripchar Valley** is located in Ladakh.
 
• **Markha Valley** is situated in the eastern part of Ladakh.
 
• **Dras** is a hill station located in the Kargil district of Ladakh.
